skill.name: outbound-prospect-list
skill.description: Build a B2B prospect list from a plain-language ideal customer profile. Use Leadsets to find matching companies and contacts, then export separate lists by work email verification status.
skill.summary: Find matching B2B prospects and export work contacts by email verification status.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The 25 static alerts match Markdown formatting, documented Leadsets links, or routine prospecting instructions. No evidence of shell execution, host reconnaissance, credential harvesting, or attempts to override the audit was found. Separate risks concern user-supplied addresses sent for verification, incomplete email exclusions, and spreadsheet export safety.

remediation.issue: Undisclosed transfer of user-supplied email addresses for verification.
remediation.suggestion: Name Leadsets as the recipient and obtain user approval before submitting user-supplied addresses. Send only the addresses needed for the requested checks.

remediation.issue: Email exclusions are not enforced by an explicit check before export.
remediation.suggestion: Apply normalized domain and email exclusions after enrichment and before exporting any segment or adding contacts to LinkedCamp. Test with a do-not-contact address.

remediation.issue: External contact values are not marked as literal text for spreadsheet export.
remediation.suggestion: Use literal-text writes in Google Sheets and neutralize formula interpretation in CSV exports. Test the resulting files in supported spreadsheet applications.

semantic_findings.title: User-Supplied Emails May Be Shared Without Approval
semantic_findings.description: The verification step includes user-supplied addresses with no status. It does not require notice or approval before sending these addresses to Leadsets.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions name the external service and explicitly include user-supplied addresses. No approval step for that transfer is specified.

semantic_findings.title: Email Exclusions May Be Missed Before Export
semantic_findings.description: The skill accepts do-not-contact email addresses, but its procedure and final checks only enforce domain exclusions. A suppressed address could reach an export or campaign.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The input rules accept email exclusions, while the explicit checks name only domains. An agent might infer an email check, but the workflow does not require it.

semantic_findings.title: Spreadsheet Exports Lack Formula Safety Rules
semantic_findings.description: The skill exports provider-sourced fields to CSV or Google Sheets without requiring literal-text handling. Spreadsheet software could interpret an untrusted value as a formula.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow exports provider text without specifying formula protection. Whether a value is interpreted as a formula depends on the connector and spreadsheet software.

content.value_statement: Finding companies that fit your criteria and checking work emails takes time. Build a Leadsets prospect list from plain-language criteria and separate contacts by verification status.
actual_capabilities: Translate an ideal customer profile into industry, company size, location, and role filters.
Check Leadsets usage and test company filters on one record before a larger search.
Find matching companies and people, retain match reasons, and cap the number of contacts per company.
Enrich contacts with role, company, and work email details.
Check addresses without a status and separate verified, catch-all, and unconfirmed contacts.
Export CSV files or use a connected destination, and report counts, record usage, and shortfalls.
limitations: Requires a Leadsets account and an MCP connection or REST API key.
Google Sheets and LinkedCamp require separate connections. The skill does not send email or start sequences.
Results depend on available records and account limits, so the requested list size may not be reached.
A verified address is not a guarantee of delivery or permission to contact the recipient.

use_cases.description: Find decision-makers at companies that fit a defined size, region, and industry before reviewing the results in CSV.

use_cases.title: Review account coverage
use_cases.description: Compare match reasons and email status in Google Sheets while limiting contacts per company.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client prospect list
use_cases.description: Build separate verified and unconfirmed lists for one client profile, then review them before any campaign import.

prompt_templates.title: Find a small set of prospects
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 10 operations directors at Canadian logistics companies with 50 to 200 employees. Export the results as CSV.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a first list with a clear target profile.

prompt_templates.title: Limit contacts per company
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 30 heads of sales at UK B2B software companies with 50 to 250 employees. Keep one contact per company and export to CSV.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prioritize company coverage over multiple contacts at one company.

prompt_templates.title: Check the filters and record allowance
prompt_templates.prompt: Target 50 finance directors at US manufacturers with 200 to 500 employees. Show me the sample match and expected record use before continuing. Export approved results to CSV.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review fit and record usage before committing to a larger search.

prompt_templates.title: Review a segmented sheet before use
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 80 revenue operations leaders at US B2B software companies with 50 to 200 employees. Keep two per company and apply my domain and email exclusions after enrichment. Show counts and match reasons first. Write the three segments to my private Google Sheet only after I approve the destination.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a larger list with a suppression check and destination approval.

output_examples.input: Find 20 operations directors at Canadian logistics companies and export to CSV.
output: Verified: 18 contacts. Catch-all: 3 contacts. Not confirmed: 2 contacts.
Two invalid addresses were counted but not exported.
The verified list was two contacts short because some work emails could not be confirmed.

output_examples.input: Find 30 UK software sales leaders, keep one per company, and export to Google Sheets.
output: The sample company matched the requested industry, location, and headcount.
The sheet contains 30 verified contacts, 6 catch-all contacts, and 4 unconfirmed contacts on separate tabs.
No company appears more than once. No messages were sent.

best_practices: Provide industry, company size, geography, and target roles. Review the sample match before a large search.
Provide domain and email exclusions, then check all segments against your do-not-contact list before import.
Review the destination and its sharing settings before export. Approve any submission of your own address list to Leadsets.
anti_patterns: Treating catch-all or unknown addresses as verified.
Repeating verification for addresses that already have a recent status without a reason.
Adding contacts to a live campaign before checking exclusions and permission to contact them.

faq.question: What information do I need to provide?
faq.answer: Specify your target industry, company size, geography, and roles. You can also set a list size, exclusions, a destination, and a per-company limit.

faq.question: What do I need to connect?
faq.answer: Use a Leadsets account with an MCP connection or REST API key. Connect Google Sheets or LinkedCamp separately to export there.

faq.question: What does verified mean?
faq.answer: Leadsets returned a verified status for that address. This does not guarantee delivery or permission to contact the recipient.

faq.question: What happens to addresses that are not verified?
faq.answer: Catch-all and unconfirmed contacts go into separate segments. Invalid addresses are counted but are not exported as contact emails.

faq.question: What happens if my account reaches a limit?
faq.answer: The skill checks available records first and may reduce the target. When it must stop, it reports progress and any available reset information.

faq.question: Does the skill send outreach messages?
faq.answer: No. It exports contacts or adds them to a selected LinkedCamp campaign, but it does not send messages or start sequences.
